limitations: Authenticated production UI is not covered by the local fixture browser tests.
No physical Android device/emulator was connected; new Android instrumentation test was added but not executed locally. Production CI builds the signed native release.
Web lunar reminder preferences are per-account on the device and browser delivery requires the website to be open; OS background delivery belongs to the native application.
Remote city lookup network errors, notification delivery at a real lunar event, all interface languages, assistive technology and slow/offline real Google-account flows were not visually tested.
UX comparisons are an expert evaluation of identical fixture screens, not measured user research. No Experimental-to-Standart consolidation has been applied.
screenshots: Local output/playwright/genesis-fixes contains before/after and paired screenshots, plus UX report HTML. Screenshot binaries are excluded from tracked production code.
